name: Fresh Broadbeans Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Peel the broad beans, and discard any nasty looking peas.
Cube tomatoes about 1 cm thick. The volume of cubed tomatoes should be roughly twice that of the peas.
Chop onion(s) very finely. The amount depends on how spicy you like your salad.
Mix it all together, then sprinkle generously with salt and olive oil.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
